page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.s2.large is an x86_64 architecture virtual machine instance within the ecs.s2 family, running on the KVM hypervisor. It features 2 dedicated vCPUs mapped to 2 physical cores with 1.0 thread per core, providing a direct physical-to-virtual core mapping. The instance is equipped with 4.0 GB of system memory, resulting in a memory-to-core ratio of 2.0 GB per core.

This instance configuration does not include any local NVMe or SSD storage, meaning all storage requirements must be met through external network-attached block storage. It also does not feature any GPU acceleration or complimentary public IPv4 addresses. The CPU flags indicate a lack of advanced vector extensions such as AVX, AVX-512, or AMX, as well as a lack of hardware-accelerated cryptography and virtualization extensions at the guest level.

Given its dedicated CPU allocation and 1:2 CPU-to-RAM ratio, the ecs.s2.large offers a predictable compute profile for entry-level workloads. The absence of local storage and advanced instruction sets positions this instance as a cost-efficient option for lightweight, non-vectorized utility tasks. It is suited for basic web serving, lightweight application hosting, small-scale development environments, and simple background processes that do not require high memory density or specialized hardware acceleration.
